thread:
Dana (CS): Quick flag: Zenith (P50 customer) requests a production demo next Tue. They are nervous about latency and will have execs on the call. We should ship an ops-friendly checklist they can run 5m before the demo.
Ben (SRE): I can do a short ops checklist. Two things first: are they streaming replies or single-shot? And what embedding/backfill activity runs overnight?
Dana (CS): Streaming chat primarily, short prompts (<80 tokens typical) but many quick back-and-forths. Embedding backfill runs nightly at 02:00 UTC (~200k vectors).
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): For short streaming sessions, prioritize: 1) local prefix cache for common conversation starts, 2) short KV cache TTLs tuned to demo window, 3) small-continuous batching (target 6). Also recommend a demo-only canary: route 10% of demo traffic to a lighter quantized model to test fallback behaviors.
Maya (Sales): Renewal note: they said they'd expand if demos go well. If we hit 99th < 220ms for three demos, great signal. Capture that metric.
Ben (SRE): Ops checklist (short) that I can hand to their SRE: 
- Prime cache (run 6min before show) via curl to /v1/prime (see snippet)
- Set streaming.flush_ms = 40 for demo routes
- Set batching.target = 6 tokens OR max_wait_ms = 25
- Set autoscale.delta = +25% for window [-5m, +15m] around demo
- Temporarily disable heavy nightly job or shift to +1h if possible

Snippet: 
```
# prime demo prefixes
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prompts":["Hi","Show me my dashboard","Where are my invoices?"]}'
```

Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Add to that: enable token-level logging for demo route and a lightweight sampling of outputs for hallucination checks. Configure sampling rate 1% to avoid overhead.
Dana (CS): Nice. Can we also provide a tiny feedback capture template they can open right after the demo? Something they can forward to execs.
Maya (Sales): I'll own exec feedback. Suggested two-question template: 1) Perceived responsiveness (1-5), 2) Any incorrect answers or confusing outputs (Y/N + short). We should also collect a screenshot of Console latency tile.
Ben (SRE): Health gating: CS to mark account health green if post-demo 99th %ile < 220ms for two consecutive demos and error rate < 0.5%. If not, change to amber and trigger SE follow-up.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: "Zenith demo prime" at 2026-04-06T08:54:00Z (owner: Dana). :calendar:
Dana (CS): Action owners: Dana -> share checklist + exec survey; Ben -> infra autoscale + healthcheck; Ibrahim -> prime script + sampling config; Maya -> exec feedback & screenshots. Will post the customer-facing PDF checklist and a 1-click prime script link by EOD.
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Quick operational note for their ops: if GPU pool becomes saturated, automatic fallback can route to cpu-quantized model (expect ~1.7x latency increase). Recommend a short note to set expectations.
Dana (CS): Great. We'll run a dry-run with their engineer tomorrow and capture any gaps. Thanks all :sparkles:
